data.name: Rushil
data.gender_notes: Rushil is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Rushil is a combination of two Sanskrit words - 'Rush' meaning 'Joy' and 'Il' meaning 'Little Sun'. It is a beautiful name that symbolizes happiness, joy, and victory. The name Rushil carries the meaning “Little Sun” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Rushil usually hope their child will grow to embody little sun and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Rushil is a name that is deeply rooted in Hindu spirituality. It is believed that the name carries the blessings of the Sun God, who is revered for his strength, energy, and vitality. It is said that a child named Rushil will grow up to be a strong, confident, and victorious individual, blessed with the radiance and light of the Sun.
data.etymology: Rushil belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Little Sun.”
